page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a 3.2 GHz base frequency. The configuration provides 16 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local SSD or NVMe storage, meaning persistent disk capacity must be provided through external cloud block storage. There are no GPU accelerators provisioned on this instance type. Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 12 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Given the balanced allocation between processing cores and memory, this server is suitable for mainstream enterprise applications, container worker nodes, relational database hosting, CI/CD runners, and general-purpose backend services requiring dedicated vCPU execution without specialized acceleration.
